newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic, AT&T settle ad dispute.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic, AT&T settle ad dispute.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp said on Thursday AT&T Corp had dismissed its lawsuit against Bell Atlantic over a disputed advertising campaign.
AT&T had filed a lawsuit against Bell Atlantic alleging some of its advertisements -- namely, the "END IS NEAR" campaign -- were false, Bell Atlantic said in a statement.
"AT&T deeply regrets the circumstances, including its own role in them, that brought these parties into court on this matter," Bell Atlantic said in a statement.
Bell Atlantic said it and other regional telephone companies had an agreement with AT&T whereby its cardholders could use the AT&T network and vice versa.
AT&T ended this agreement and Bell Atlantic advertised the "END IS NEAR," to alert its customers to the change, Bell Atlantic said.
Bell Atlantic said AT&T sued it in July.
AT&T confirmed it had reached a confidential settlement with Bell Atlantic but declined to comment further.
